title: Seafood allergy comprises IgE-defined molecular sensitization endotypes associated with distinct clinical severity profiles

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Seafood allergy comprises IgE-defined molecular sensitization endotypes associated with distinct clinical severity profiles》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Objective · abstract-2-1】This study aimed to characterize IgE-defined molecular sensitization patterns to major seafood allergens and assess their associations with clinical reaction severity.

【Background · abstract-1-1】Seafood allergy is characterized by heterogeneous IgE sensitization to distinct molecular components, but the clinical relevance of these profiles remains incompletely defined. Multiplex molecular diagnostics may help identify molecular endotypes and refine risk stratification.

evidence.text: This study aimed to characterize IgE-defined molecular sensitization patterns to major seafood allergens and assess their associations with clinical reaction severity.

Seafood allergy is characterized by heterogeneous IgE sensitization to distinct molecular components, but the clinical relevance of these profiles remains incompletely defined. Multiplex molecular diagnostics may help identify molecular endotypes and refine risk stratification.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Seafood allergy comprises IgE-defined molecular sensitization endotypes associated with distinct clinical severity profiles》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Study design and population · p0025】This multicenter prospective observational study was conducted from January 2021 to December 2025 across 3 specialized allergy centers in Northern (Lombardy and Friuli Venezia Giulia), Central (Lazio and Tuscany), and Southern Italy (Sicily). Consecutive patients undergoing molecular allergology diagnostics with ALEX2 were screened. Written informed consent was obtained from all participants, and the protocol was approved by the institutional review boards of participating centers. The research was conducted in accordance with ethical standards outlined in the World Medical Association Declaration of Helsinki. The study protocol underwent review and approval by the IDI-IRCCS’s committee, with approval number IDI-IRCCS CE | 492/1.

【Methods · abstract-3-1】In this multicenter prospective study (January 2021 to December 2025), 8,040 consecutive patients screened with the ALEX2 multiplex immunoassay were evaluated; 787 (9.8%) were sensitized to ≥1 seafood-derived molecule. Sensitization to parvalbumin, tropomyosin, Ani s 1, arginine kinase, and other muscle-related proteins was analyzed in relation to prospectively collected clinical phenotypes (mild, moderate, and severe). Venn analysis, principal component analysis, and unsupervised hierarchical clustering explored molecular patterns. Multivariable binary logistic regression models were fitted for each severity category versus all others, adjusting for age and sex. Associations are reported as odds ratios (ORs) with 95% CIs.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Seafood allergy comprises IgE-defined molecular sensitization endotypes associated with distinct clinical severity profiles》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Results · abstract-4-1】Tropomyosin (45%), arginine kinase (37%), parvalbumin (24%), and Ani s 1 (12%) were the most prevalent sensitizations and showed limited overlap, delineating largely distinct molecular profiles. Hierarchical clustering and 3-dimensional principal component analysis confirmed the separation of major components in multivariate space, with distinct loading patterns. In adjusted analyses, parvalbumin (adjusted odds ratio [OR_adj], 3.7) and Ani s 1 (OR_adj, 2.7) were associated with severe reactions, tropomyosin with moderate reactions (OR_adj, 2.0), and arginine kinase with mild phenotypes (OR_adj, 5.3).

【Principal findings and conceptual framework · p0115】In this large multicenter cohort, multiplex molecular profiling revealed that seafood allergy is not a uniform entity but comprises discrete IgE sensitization patterns that are reproducibly associated with distinct clinical phenotypes.

Hierarchical clustering and 3-dimensional principal component analysis confirmed the separation of major components in multivariate space, with distinct loading patterns. In adjusted analyses, parvalbumin (adjusted odds ratio [OR_adj], 3.7) and Ani s 1 (OR_adj, 2.7) were associated with severe reactions, tropomyosin with moderate reactions (OR_adj, 2.0), and arginine kinase with mild phenotypes (OR_adj, 5.3).

In this large multicenter cohort, multiplex molecular profiling revealed that seafood allergy is not a uniform entity but comprises discrete IgE sensitization patterns that are reproducibly associated with distinct clinical phenotypes.

sections.title: 图表阅读
sections.text:
《Seafood allergy comprises IgE-defined molecular sensitization endotypes associated with distinct clinical severity profiles》：图表的原始标题与说明。

【Fig 1 · fig1】Fig 1 Molecular sensitization patterns to seafood allergens. (A) Venn diagram showing overlap of sensitization to Ani s 1, tropomyosin, arginine kinase, and parvalbumin (absolute counts and percentages of the 787 sensitized subjects). (B) Three-dimensional PCA plot of the 8 seafood allergen components. Sphere volume is proportional to the prevalence of sensitization in the study population. Spatial separation along the principal component axes (PC1-PC3) reflects differences in IgE reactivity patterns identified by unsupervised analysis. The proportion of variance explained by each principal component is indicated on the corresponding axis; notably, PC3 explains 16.1% of the total variance. AK, Arginine kinase; ENO/ALD, enolase/aldolase; TnC, troponin C; MLC, myosin light chain; SCBP, sarcoplasmic calcium-binding protein; PC1, first principal component; PC2, second principal component; PC3, third principal component.

【Fig 2 · fig2】Fig 2 Hierarchical clustering of panallergen reactivity profiles and associated clinical severity. Heatmap with hierarchical clustering of allergen-specific IgE profiles. Rows: allergen components; columns: subjects (n = 787). Color scale: green (no reactivity); black: presence of IgE reactivity without clinical symptoms (asymptomatic sensitization); deep red: mild symptoms (predominantly oral allergy syndrome); red: moderate systemic reactions; bright red: severe reactions, including anaphylaxis as defined in the Methods section. Dendrograms indicate clustering of components and subjects.
